 Al Ahli Saudi vs Al Nassr Tonight: Ronaldo Faces Ivan Toney, Check Schedule and Standings
 The Saudi Pro League clash between Al Ahli and Al Nassr features a showdown between Cristiano Ronaldo and top scorer Ivan Toney. Check the match schedule and current standings.
 By: Damar Prasetya 
 | 
 Editor: Nayla Savitri 
 | 
 Contributor: Hanif Ramadhan 
 November 21, 2026 at 1:17 AM WITA ·
 6 min read
 Al Ahli and Al Nassr players compete for the ball during a Saudi Pro League match in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, January 2, 2026. Photo: Saudi Press Agency (SPA)/Archive. 
 JEDDAH, Aktualita.co -  The match between Al Ahli Saudi and Al Nassr is one of the most anticipated fixtures in the 2026/2027 Saudi Pro League season. Both teams are scheduled to meet at Alinma Stadium, King Abdullah Sports City, Jeddah, on Friday (11/20/2026) evening Saudi time, or early Saturday (11/21/2026) morning Indonesian time. 
 This duel brings together two major forces of Saudi Arabian football with different objectives. Al Nassr, led by Cristiano Ronaldo , is looking to maintain its position at the top of the table, while Al Ahli needs a win to improve its standing following a disappointing result in their previous match.

 The encounter also features a clash of star players, ranging from Cristiano Ronaldo, João Félix, and Sadio Mané for Al Nassr, to Ivan Toney, Francisco Trincão, and Roger Ibañez, who are key figures for Al Ahli. 
 Al Ahli Saudi vs Al Nassr Schedule and Live Broadcast 
 According to the official Saudi Pro League schedule, the match between Al Ahli and Al Nassr is a rescheduled ninth-week fixture set for November 20, 2026. 
 The match will kick off at 20:30 Saudi time, equivalent to Saturday, November 21, 2026, at 00:30 WIB or 01:30 WITA. 
 Alinma Stadium in Jeddah will host the match. Playing at home gives Al Ahli the opportunity to leverage supporter backing while aiming to end the positive trend currently enjoyed by the visitors. 
 For viewers in Indonesia, this match is listed on the SPOTV 2 broadcast schedule. However, the availability of broadcasts and streaming services remains subject to broadcasting rights and schedule changes. 
 Al Nassr and Al Ahli Standings Ahead of the Match 
 The race for the Saudi Pro League title this season is intense. Al Hilal remains at the top of the table with 30 points from 11 matches. 
 Al Nassr sits in third place with 28 points from 11 matches. The Riyadh-based team has recorded nine wins, one draw, and one loss. 
 Meanwhile, Al Ahli is in sixth place with 21 points after 11 matches. They have collected seven wins but have also suffered four defeats. 
 With a seven-point gap between the two teams, a win is crucial for Al Ahli to narrow the distance to the top four. 
 Conversely, three additional points would bring Al Nassr to 31 points, giving them a chance to overtake Al Hilal for the top spot. 
 Cristiano Ronaldo and João Félix Pose a Threat to Al Ahli 
 Al Nassr arrives with relatively convincing form. In their previous league match, Ange Postecoglou's side defeated Al Kholood 5-3. 
 Cristiano Ronaldo remains a primary attacking pillar. The Portuguese player has scored eight goals in his 10 league appearances this season. 
 However, Al Nassr's strength does not rely solely on Ronaldo. 
 João Félix has also made significant contributions with three goals and seven assists. This record places him among the most productive attacking creators in the competition. 
 The presence of Sadio Mané and Ângelo Gabriel further enriches Al Nassr's attacking options. Their movement can create space for Ronaldo to find opportunities inside the penalty box. 
 The visitors also have Bento as a goalkeeper, who has become a key pillar of their defensive strength. 
 Ivan Toney is Al Ahli's Hope 
 For the hosts, Ivan Toney is the player to watch. According to Saudi Pro League data ahead of the match, the English striker has collected 12 goals in nine league matches. 
 This productivity places him at the top of the goalscoring list and makes him a serious threat to Al Nassr's backline. 
 In addition to Toney, Al Ahli has Francisco Trincão, who has already scored six goals. The creativity of Eduard Spertsyan and the speed of Galeno can also help the hosts break down the opponent's defense. 
 Nevertheless, Al Ahli faces the challenge of improving its defensive organization after a heavy 1-6 loss to Al Shabab in their last league match. 
 Al Ahli coach, Marino Pušić, stated that his team has prepared well for this important match. 
 “The match against the defending champions will be tough. They are a quality team, but we also have high quality,” said Al Ahli coach, Marino Pušić, in a pre-match press conference. 
 Pušić also emphasized the importance of concentration and the readiness of all players. The support of the fans in Jeddah is expected to be an added motivation for a comeback. 
 Statistics and Head-to-Head Record of Al Ahli vs Al Nassr 
 The match between Al Ahli and Al Nassr is expected to feature intense competition in the midfield. 
 Official Saudi Pro League data shows both teams have recorded 54 successful ball recoveries in the final third of the opponent's half. 
 Al Ahli has recorded 102 high-area ball recoveries, while Al Nassr has logged 95. These statistics show both teams' tendency to apply pressure from the opponent's defensive area. 
 In terms of head-to-head records, Al Nassr has had better results in recent duels. 
 On April 29, 2026, Al Nassr defeated Al Ahli 2-0. However, in the previous match on January 2, 2026, Al Ahli managed to win 3-2 while playing in Jeddah. 
 These results show that superiority on paper does not necessarily determine the outcome of the match. 
 Predicted Lineups for Al Ahli vs Al Nassr 
 Al Ahli is expected to use a 4-2-3-1 formation to optimize wing play and the sharpness of Ivan Toney as a center-forward. 
 Predicted Al Ahli (4-2-3-1): Edouard Mendy; Saeed Baattia, Mohammed Sulaiman, Roger Ibañez, Abubacarr Kinteh; Artem Bondarenko, Valentin Atangana; Francisco Trincão, Eduard Spertsyan, Galeno; Ivan Toney. 
 Meanwhile, Al Nassr is expected to use a 4-4-1-1 formation with João Félix moving behind Cristiano Ronaldo. 
 Predicted Al Nassr (4-4-1-1): Bento; Nawaf Boushal, Abdulelah Al-Amri, Iñigo Martínez, Awad Aman; Ayman Yahya, Ângelo, Samú Costa, Sadio Mané; João Félix; Cristiano Ronaldo. 
 These lineups are still predictions and may change according to the coach's decisions leading up to the match. 
 Who Has a Better Chance of Winning? 
 Looking at recent performance and league standings, Al Nassr has better momentum heading into this match. 
 However, Al Ahli still has the potential to put up a fierce fight, especially through the sharpness of Ivan Toney and the support of the Jeddah public. 
 The key to the match will likely lie in both teams' ability to control the midfield, anticipate counter-attacks, and capitalize on opportunities in front of the goal. 
 For Al Nassr, a win would be an important step in the race for the top of the Saudi Pro League. For Al Ahli, three points could serve as a momentum for revival and restore the team's confidence. 
 With the quality of players on both sides, the duel between Al Ahli Saudi and Al Nassr has the potential to be an open match full of opportunities throughout the 90 minutes.
